state_source.description: Received gC message contains complete or partial state; fields not in a gC should be kept from prior state.

hero_identity.description: HERO_ID is registered_message.currentPlayer.id; it is also the key for the hero's private cards and street contributions.

hero_actions_source.description: Only this client's outgoing actions are present in SENT action messages; opponents appear only as gC state changes.

pot.path: gC.pot; if current-street bets exist then pot + sum(numeric gC.tB values) is current pot

players.path: registered_message.gameState.players merged with gC.players and gC.pGS

hero_position.path: derived from gC.dealerID, gC.sBPI, gC.bBPI relative to HERO_ID

showdown.path: gC.gameResult plus gC.pC showing true hole-cards

card_encoding_only_if_needed.description: Card strings are rank then suit, e.g. '9h'; null/absent in pC means the card is not visible to hero.

phase.description: Use gC.gT[1]: 0 hand-start/pre-flop, 1 flop, 2 turn, 3 river, 5 settlement; verify with oTC public-card count and gameResult presence.

to_call.description: to_call = max(cHB - current_street_hero_contribution, 0); current_street_hero_contribution is numeric tB[HERO_ID], else 0; if no cHB then to_call=0.

action_history.description: No explicit action-history field is populated. Build from SENT hero actions plus gC diffs in tB/cHB; amount growth on a player implies bet/call, 'check' implies check. Dedupe gC frames that only update timers and do not change decision state.

new_hand.description: New hand starts when gC has fresh two-card hero pC, gC.gT[1]=0, dealer/blinds rotate, and previous gameResult is cleared.

state_merge.description: Treat each gC as an incremental patch; omitted fields keep previous values. tB is current-street contribution; '<D>' clears old street values. Pot may be the pre-bet pot; current pot should be pot plus numeric tB sums until settlement resets pot.

alternatives: gT[1]=4 may be an all-in/showdown-only street
gC.pot is pot before current-street bets and tB must be added
ambiguities.reason: pot is missing during current-street betting, and pot=0 at settlement while gameResult reports gained 120.
Capture contains no opponent SENT action messages.

validations.reason: gT street index aligns with number of public cards and settlement result.
Registered currentPlayer is the same player whose pC cards have values in gC.
cHB=20 with no hero tB was followed by a hero PLAYER_CALL.
Pot field is absent in several current-street frames and resets to 0 while gameResult.gained=120.
No complete action stream for all players exists in this capture.
